title: Parts of the body
descriptionFa: اسم اعضای سر و صورت، دست و پا، بدن و داخل بدن.

words.example: I hit my head on the kitchen door.
Wash your face with cold water in the morning.
words.tipFa: با اعضای بدن my, your, his, her می‌گیم: I wash my face، نه I wash the face.

words.example: Sara has long black hair.
words.tipFa: hair مفرده: My hair is long، نه My hairs are long.

words.example: I've got something in my eye.
My nose is red because I have a cold.
I have a pain in my ear.
Don't talk with your mouth full!
He was nervous and bit his lip.
My little brother lost his first tooth today.
She wore a warm scarf around her neck.
He carried his bag on one shoulder.
She broke her arm when she fell off her bike.
words.tipFa: فارسی به arm و hand هر دو «دست» می‌گه؛ hand فقط از مچ به پایینه.

words.example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
She wears a ring on her finger.
The baby is sucking his thumb.
I broke a nail when I opened the box.

words.meaningFa: پا (کل پا، از ران تا مچ)
words.example: I ran ten kilometres and now my leg hurts.
words.tipFa: فارسی به leg و foot هر دو «پا» می‌گه؛ foot فقط کف و روی پاست.

words.example: He hurt his knee playing football.
Can you stand on one foot for a minute?
I hit my toe on the table leg.
He went to the doctor with a pain in his chest.
I usually sleep on my side.
words.tipFa: side معنی «طرف، کنار» هم می‌ده: the left side of the road.

words.example: My stomach hurts because I ate too much.
Sit up straight. It's good for your back.
These trousers are too big around the waist.
My grandmother has a pain in her left hip.
Use sun cream to protect your skin in summer.
Your heart beats about seventy times a minute.
The brain controls the whole body.
The nurse took some blood from my arm.

gapQuestions.sentence: I can't hear very well in my left ___.
She wears her wedding ring on this ___.
gapQuestions.hintFa: دست پنج تا از این داره.

gapQuestions.sentence: Your ___ sends blood around your body.
Puzzles and chess are good exercise for your ___.
In football, you kick the ball with your ___.
The ___ is the short, thick finger on your hand.
Your ___ is in the middle of your leg. It bends when you sit.
The dentist checked every ___ in my mouth.
Comb your ___ before you go out.
My trousers are too small. They don't close at the ___.
